rule: A cell may reach PROVEN_T2 only if it matches a pod here whose status is pre_registered. Pods must be declared before the forward data they will be judged on exists; a pod extracted from the results being judged is post_hoc and cannot promote. Everything unmatched is discovery.

status_meaning.pre_registered: may confer confirmatory; judged on forward rows from registered_at
status_meaning.post_hoc: recorded for the audit trail only; cannot confer confirmatory
status_meaning.declined: evaluated and rejected; recorded so nobody re-proposes it blind

pods.thesis: Breakout continuation on liquid US equities/ETFs is the one family where this system already shows positive out-of-sample statistics (EQUITY OOS Sharpe +0.61 on 33 folds, ETF +0.21 on 53).
pods.expression: Monthly/weekly cadence only. Exit on time or a 2-3 ATR trail, vol-scaled size, no fixed take-profit. ETF daily cadence is ruled out: measured slippage is 234% of per-trade PnL.
pods.acceptance_criteria: Forward rows dated after 2026-11-19: n>=100, net CI lower bound > 0 at 2x measured slippage, IR>=0.5 vs a matched SPY leg, split-half stable. CI-LB<=0 at day 30 or 60 ends the pod.
pods.evidence_at_registration: EQUITY is the only class with positive walk-forward OOS Sharpe; individual breakout cells straddle zero.

pods.thesis: LuxAlgo confluence shorts carry positive expectancy after costs on n=476 (+0.67%/trade, CI [+0.35,+0.96], DSR 0.977).
pods.why_not_promotable: Registered after the rows were scored, so it cannot confer confirmatory status. Also 97.7% single-source, and the LONG side of the same strategy is a proven-harm cell (n=754, -0.33%/trade) - the sign flip points at short beta rather than an edge.
pods.acceptance_criteria: Observe only. Requires an independent second source, a BTC-beta regression, and 90 days of forward rows before re-registration.

pods.decline_reason: The 'grade A / score>=60' cluster is a reconstructed segment proxy, not a strategy: 'grade A' and 'score>=60' are the same 33 rows to four decimals, and elite_grade B (n=72) is the superset. n=33 cannot carry a pod, and the CRYPTO class aggregate is a proven-harm cell.
pods.revisit_if: A named emitter (not a score attribute) accumulates n>=100 forward rows with positive net CI in a class that is not KILL.
